# IRS SOI county and state income fixtures

Delaware (state 10: Kent 001, New Castle 003, Sussex 005) for tax years 2022
and 2023, plus SOI's Historic Table 2 state file for 2023 (rows `US`, `DE`
and `OA`, Other Areas).

| File | SOI product | Rows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `22incyallnoagi.csv`, `23incyallnoagi.csv` | County data, all returns (`agi_stub` 0) | Delaware's total (`COUNTYFIPS` 000) and its three counties |
| `22incyallagi.csv`, `23incyallagi.csv` | County data by size of AGI (`agi_stub` 1-8) | The same four places, eight bands each |
| `23in55cmcsv.csv` | Historic Table 2, every state (`AGI_STUB` 0-10) | `US`, `DE`, `OA`, eleven rows each |

These files follow SOI's published layout as read on 2026-11-05: the county
header begins `STATEFIPS,STATE,COUNTYFIPS,COUNTYNAME,agi_stub,N1,...`, values
carry four decimals (`2149320.0000`), and the state file begins
`STATE,AGI_STUB,N1,...` with numbers written with thousands separators inside
quotes (`"159,949,000"`). The column set is reduced to the keys, `N1`,
`MARS1`, `MARS2` and the registered items, and the values are generated by
`make_soi_fixtures.py` (kept with the plan's checkpoint, not in the package)
so that counties sum to the state total and bands sum to all returns exactly
as SOI's files do.

They are not byte copies of SOI's files: the cloud build host cannot reach
irs.gov. Replace them with the verbatim Delaware rows from OFFICE_LAB before
the first scheduled run is trusted, and keep the file names.
